findings.evidence: docs/internal/product/milestones/M10.md line 4 (the description: field) reads 'seeded schedules, injected faults, and pauses rather than only kills' with no scoping footnote, in the same file whose completion-condition sentence (line ~130) and task 6 (line ~93) were each given a scoping footnote by M10.34 and M10.37 respectively -- compare the fixed sentences against the untouched frontmatter three lines above the Goal section. docs/internal/product/milestones/M15.md line 40-41 states 'Chaos test harness combining every fault class from M10's simulation -- kills, pauses, partitions, 503 storms', directly attributing partitions to M10's delivered capability, which M10.0/M10.34 established is false (the only partition M10.md enumerated is deferred to M7). M10.34's own commit (2a8272d) swept M10.md, roadmap.md and M6.md but never touched M15.md or M10.md's frontmatter -- confirmed via git show 2a8272d --stat.
findings.summary: The 'pauses'/'pauses and partitions' overclaim that M10.34 and M10.37 each spent a dedicated commit scoping still stands, unscoped, in two more places neither sweep visited: M10.md's own YAML frontmatter description line, and M15.md task 1.
